base_prompt: Turkish alternative pop, intimate live studio band, instrumental only. Warm acoustic guitar, expressive piano, melodic electric bass, real drum kit, restrained clean electric guitar. Cohesive memorable recurring two-bar lead motif, human microtiming and touch, breathing room for a future singer. No EDM drop, no genre switch, no dense synth layers, no vocals or speech. Key B minor, 104 BPM, 4/4. Lead motif: The two-bar melodic hook peaks on 'Biz bu şehri' using a syncopated eighth-note pickup starting on the dominant F#4, leaping to the minor third D5 on the downbeat of bar one, then descending step-wise through C#5 and B4. In the second bar, on 'yanlış yerinden sevdik', the melody hovers on A4 before resolving down to F#4 with a soft, breathy fall, leaving a rhythmic pause before the next line..

timeline.name: intro
timeline.arrangement: A sparse, melancholic fingerpicked acoustic guitar in B minor sets a reflective mood. A faint ambient layer of distant city traffic and harbor sounds sits low in the mix.

timeline.name: verse_1
timeline.arrangement: A dry, damp kick drum and a subtle rimshot enter on beats 2 and 4. A warm, melodic bass guitar outlines the roots, playing soft half-notes with no high-end transients.

timeline.name: pre_1
timeline.arrangement: The drum groove drops out, replaced by a swelling analog pad that builds harmonic tension. The acoustic guitar shifts from fingerpicking to delicate, ringing arpeggios.

timeline.name: chorus_1
timeline.arrangement: The arrangement opens up with a wide, strummed acoustic guitar and a steady, organic drum beat with a live snare. A clean, single-note electric guitar line doubles the vocal hook tail.
timeline.chords: Gmaj7 | A | F#m7 | Bm | Gmaj7 | A | Em7 | F#7

timeline.name: turnaround
timeline.arrangement: A brief instrumental transition. The drums drop back to a simple kick-rim pattern while a warm, analog synth lead plays a brief, nostalgic counter-melody.

timeline.name: verse_2
timeline.arrangement: The verse groove returns, but with a slightly more active bassline that moves melodically around the scale degrees. The rimshot is treated with a light spring reverb.

timeline.name: pre_2
timeline.arrangement: Identical structure to Pre 1, but with an added shaker and swelling electric guitar volume swells to create a stronger sense of urgency leading into the chorus.

timeline.name: chorus_2
timeline.arrangement: Full band expression. Double-tracked acoustic guitars provide a lush rhythmic foundation. The electric guitar hook is more prominent, panned slightly to the left.
timeline.chords: Gmaj7 | A | F#m7 | Bm | Gmaj7 | A | Em7 | F#7

timeline.name: bridge
timeline.arrangement: The rhythm section drops out completely. A warm, sub-heavy Rhodes piano and a single fingerpicked acoustic guitar accompany the vocal. The bass plays low, sustaining root notes on Gmaj7.

timeline.name: final_chorus
timeline.arrangement: The dynamic peak of the track. Tambourine is added to the high end of the drum groove. The bassline locks tightly with the kick while playing melodic fills. High string pads lift the emotional weight.
timeline.chords: Gmaj7 | A | F#m7 | Bm | Gmaj7 | A | Em7 | F#7 | Bm

timeline.name: outro
timeline.arrangement: The instruments fade away one by one, leaving only the solo fingerpicked acoustic guitar from the intro. The song ends on a final, unresolved Bm9 chord sustaining into silence.
